description: Work items for the next rehearsal (the repository's Rehearsal 4) and the event. 'dependsOn' edges are genuine: the prerequisite produces a decision, contract, artifact or evidence the task consumes, or a normative rule forbids starting earlier (cited in the reason). 'preferenceAfter' edges are ordering preferences and are never scheduled. 'covers' uses the selector grammar of requirements-compiler (id, prefix:, regex:, doc:, origin:). satisfiedBy: new-implementation, existing-capability, operator-action, upstream-release, verification. 'phase': preflight tasks finish before the R4 timer starts (it starts at the first green bootstrap CI, R4 P5); timed tasks run inside the 420-minute ceiling. 'conditionalOn' names an owner decision that may exclude the task with approval.
